text:
Sam B - sales: Quick sync — FinServeCo POC landed (legal wants a 6-week run). They asked about deployment mode and region. Any objections to recommending Dedicated in eu-west-1 with VPC peering?

Jia (solutions): 👍 sounds reasonable. They need strict data residency + predictable latency. Proposed scope: invoice parsing + redaction -> generation + retrieval. Success criteria below.

Ryan (eng): We can support Dedicated in eu-west-1. Perf targets: p95 <250ms for 512-token gen at 8 concurrent streams, throughput 100 reqs/min. Need to pick model family (e.g., redgpt-2/llama-compat) and quantization plan.

Omar (sec): Security checklist: must complete SQA (security questionnaire) and provide KMS integration plan. They want key residency in customer KMS — Private control plane preferred, but Dedicated with customer KMS via KMS proxy can work. I'll send the SQA.

Alexa (AM): Pricing ask from FinServeCo: they want Opex-style monthly predictable cost. We should propose a 3-4 GPU Dedicated commit for 6 weeks and a Hosted fallback for dev. Will draft pricing tiers.

Jia (solutions): Suggested success criteria (concise):
- Functional: parser extracts invoice fields with >95% accuracy on their test set
- Quality: generation answers pass 90% of eval prompts (eval set of 120 prompts)
- Latency: p95 <250ms for gen, p50 <120ms
- Reliability: <1% error rate over 24h soak
- Integration: VPC peering + KMS tested end-to-end

Ryan (eng): Add infra acceptance: model pinning + rollback test, KV cache enabled, and measurable token cost per 1k tokens < target we set. We can run a baseline eval in week 1 to tune quantization.

Sam B - sales: Timeline proposal:
- Week 0: Kickoff + SQA sent
- Week 1: Data ingest + baseline eval (we run eval harness)
- Week 2: Perf tuning (batching, quant, routing)
- Week 3-4: End-to-end validation + security verification
- Week 5: Customer acceptance test
- Week 6: Wrap + next-steps (pilot contract)

Omar (sec): Notes: send SQA form to their security lead. They asked about SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence and pen-test window. Also need to confirm whether PHI/PII flows — if yes, we must recommend Private (on-prem) OR dedicated with strict egress rules.

Jia (solutions): For region decision: they operate across EU + UK, but data sits in Ireland. Recommend eu-west-1 primary, uk-south as DR if needed. Also propose using our Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 with region pinning.

Alexa (AM): Pricing sketch to propose in the SOW: 6-week Dedicated commit equivalent to 4 A100s (monthly prorated) + managed setup fee. Include optional Private onboarding fees if they choose customer-managed control plane.

Ryan (eng): Quick config snippet for infra team (example):
```
model: redgpt-2-quant
region: eu-west-1
capacity: reserved:4gpus
network: vpc_peering: true
kms: customer_kms
```

Sam B - sales: Blockers? Any enterprise gotchas we should call out before sending proposal?

Omar (sec): Blocker: if they require keys never leave customer KMS and no plaintext logs in our control plane, that's a Private deployment ask and will add ~4-6 weeks to timeline. Flagging to sales.

Jia (solutions): Also ask product team for eval harness for invoice prompts. We'll need their golden dataset and rubric.

Alexa (AM): I'll prepare the SOW draft and include two tracks: Dedicated (recommended) + Private (fallback if security mandates). Will include clear acceptance criteria and an option to convert to Dedicated annual commit.

deploy-bot: reservation created — dedicated-pool-eu-west-1: hold 4 gpus for 6 weeks (provisional)

Sam B - sales: Perfect. Omar, please send SQA today. Jia/ryan, we'll schedule kickoff Tues 09:00 CET. Alexa, send SOW draft by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
